WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios,
  SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count,
  AVG(g.match_count - a.avg_match_count) AS average_excess_match_count
FROM group_stats AS g
CROSS JOIN average_count AS a
WHERE g.match_count > a.avg_match_count;
